issues.description: The reference solution for Aufgabe 02 returns an extra column (Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel) that is not requested by the problem statement. The exercise explicitly instructs students to output "genau die geforderten Daten und nicht mehr." The extra column in the solution contradicts the problem specification and may confuse students about the expected output or cause mismatches with automated checks.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the unrequested column Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel from the SELECT list in solution_repository/aufgabe02.sql so the solution returns only Freizeitpark.name, Freizeitpark.strasse, and Gemeinde.name. Alternatively, if the gemeindeschluessel was intentionally required, update the problem statement to explicitly request it.
